description: Saves a report to a Google Drive, OneDrive or SharePoint folder after its runs, as the app's scheduling panel does, replacing the setting it had. Each save replaces the same file, or archives a dated copy first with `archive`. The folder is opened with the user's own Google or Microsoft account, which saves the report from then on. To save it now, start a run with startReportRun: a run that doesn't fail then tries to save it when `trigger` is `all`, and getReportCloudExport tells whether the save worked, since a failed save doesn't fail the run. Set `trigger` to `none` to stop saving it. Only its editors may.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

datestampSuffix.description: How `archive` dates the copies it keeps, as a moment.js format such as `MM/DD/YYYY` or `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to `MM/DD/YYYY`.

fileName.description: The saved file's name. If omitted, the report's name.

folderUrl.description: The folder to save the report in, by its link: a Google Drive folder's link (or its id) with `google`, or a OneDrive or SharePoint folder's link with `microsoft`. It's opened with your own Google or Microsoft account connected to Rollstack, which then saves the report, so you must be able to add files to it.

ignoreFailuresOnArchive.description: With `archive`, whether a copy that fails still lets the save go on. Defaults to `false`.

provider.description: Where the report is saved: `google` saves it to Google Drive as a Google Slides presentation, with its charts as linked Google Sheets charts, and `microsoft` saves it to OneDrive or SharePoint as a PowerPoint file with native charts.

trigger.description: Which runs save it: `all` after every run that doesn't fail, `scheduled` only after the report's scheduled runs, and `none` never, which stops saving it and keeps the setting.

updateMethod.description: `update` replaces the saved file with the new version. `archive` first copies the saved file, named with the date of its last save in `datestampSuffix`, then replaces it. Defaults to `update`.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: updateReportCloudExport
title: Set cloud save
